units: Gen. R. s. 87, beg. (ref. to Ps. CXXV, 3) אין לו ה׳ וכ׳ finds no ease in the company of &c.—הֲנָחַת רוח peace of mind, appeasement. Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26ᵃ (interch. with נחת רוח).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:23">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot.; Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ bot. <he>בעושה ה׳ רותו וכ׳</he> when he gives his father ease of mind (by obeying his wishes).
